channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: sapper-v2: run an autonomous pentest legion on your own lab — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: sapper-v2 (N1nEmAn/sapper-v2) is a multi-agent pentest harness that won the 3rd Tencent Cloud Intelligent Attack-Defense Challenge — 634 teams, 80.18/100, 8 hours unattended, on 1B tokens where the runner-up burned 4.5B. This guide installs the CLI, sets up a project with a shared fact graph, drives one commander loop by hand, then lets the legion run itself — plus the full Docker legion for competition-style campaigns.

item.title: GPT-6 Cyber: OpenAI launches its cybersecurity model that found 948 Linux exploits
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model rated “Critical” under its Preparedness Framework. It scored 48.5% on ExploitGym, found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws, and built working exploits for 948 Linux kernel vulnerabilities — while staying inside researchers’ rules of engagement 99.93% of the time.

item.title: PLaMo 3 Translate: PFN's open-weight translation LLM runs offline on a phone in 53 languages
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Preferred Networks has released the weights for PLaMo 3 Translate, a translation-specialized LLM in four sizes from 0.8B to 31B. The smallest model beats rivals 30 times its size — and runs on a smartphone in airplane mode.

item.title: Kimi K3 on a single server: Skymizer and MiTAC fit a 2.8T-parameter model into one air-cooled box
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Skymizer and MiTAC will show Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running on a single air-cooled server with eight HTX301 LPU cards and 2 TB of card memory at SC26.

item.title: Supermicro KV cache storage with IBM and NVIDIA: 56x faster first tokens on 130,000-token prompts
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Supermicro, IBM and NVIDIA launched a shared KV cache storage solution for long-context AI inference. Joint testing with a 120-billion-parameter model showed up to 56x faster time-to-first-token on 130,000-token prompts.

item.title: AI runs on light: Tokyo team's optical deep-learning framework cuts compute by about 40%
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Researchers at the University of Tokyo and NTT have built a deep-learning framework that runs on light instead of electricity, matching conventional neural networks while using roughly 40% less compute.

item.title: OpenAI Community Compact: AI campuses will pay their own power bills and stop asking officials to sign NDAs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI published its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint on November 5, 2026: future campuses it owns and operates will pay the full cost of their electricity and grid infrastructure, publish site-level water and power use, and stop requiring public officials to sign NDAs.

item.title: FLUX.1 [dev]: generate images on your own GPU — hands-on with Black Forest Labs' open-weights model
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: FLUX.1 [dev] (black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev) is a 12-billion-parameter open-weights image model you can run on your own GPU. This guide installs it with diffusers, generates a first image, tunes guidance and steps, and covers the faster FLUX.1 [schnell] variant — plus the hardware it really needs.

item.title: Yukie for Business: GlobalGPT’s AI agent monitors your data and builds websites, forms, and chatbots
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GlobalGPT launched Yukie for Business 1.0 on November 5, 2026: an AI agent that watches a small business’s data for changes, follows up on emails and meeting notes, and builds websites, forms, and customer-service chatbots from a conversation. It is available now at glbgpt.com.

item.title: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: Baidu’s 280B open-weights model for fine-tuning — with a license that excludes the EU
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Baidu released the pre-training checkpoint of ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 14 billion parameters per token — its first open-weights release in 16 months — under a custom license that excludes the EU, UK, and South Korea.

item.title: Cohere partners with Singapore's CSIT to run sovereign AI inside national-security networks
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cohere will deploy its enterprise AI models and North agent platform inside Singapore's defence agency CSIT, after a pilot proved it could run AI in secure on-premises environments.

item.title: Capgemini to lead EU AI Safety consortium assessing cyber risks of advanced AI models
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Capgemini will lead a consortium with Wavestone and France's LNE to assess the cyber risks of advanced general-purpose AI models for the European Commission's AI Office, under the EU AI Act.

item.title: Chatterbox voice cloning: clone a voice on your own machine, free — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Chatterbox (resemble-ai/chatterbox, MIT, 27,576 GitHub stars) clones a voice from a 10-second clip and speaks 23 languages — free, on your own machine. This guide installs it, clones a voice with the Turbo model, takes the same voice into a second language, and checks the watermark baked into every file.

item.title: SensAI Gateway and Helm: AI security screening that reads nervous-system signals at checkpoints
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SensAI Veritas launched SensAI Gateway and SensAI Helm on November 5, 2026, an AI screening platform for security checkpoints that analyzes autonomic nervous system responses through one standard camera — no contact, no wearables — and routes cases for clearance or further assessment, with officers keeping final authority.

item.title: Canva restructure hits 1,271 roles as AI costs bite and growth slows for the first time in a decade
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Canva said on November 4, 2026, that 1,271 people — 22% of its workforce — will be affected by a restructure merging its Product, Growth and Platform teams, cutting management layers and centring more product teams in Sydney, as growth slows for the first time in a decade.

item.title: CrowdStrike Agentic Adversary Emulation: an AI red team that attacks, hardens, then re-attacks to prove the fix
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: CrowdStrike unveiled Agentic Adversary Emulation on November 4, 2026, at Fal.Con Europe: SafeMind-powered offensive AI that red-teams a customer's Falcon environment like an agentic adversary, chaining weaknesses into attack paths, driving fixes, and re-running the attack to validate each path is closed. It is in early access for select customers through Project QuiltWorks partners.

item.title: Semarak AI Malaysia: AWS puts Quick and Kiro in the hands of 445,000 civil servants and 10,000 SMEs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Amazon Web Services launched Semarak AI Malaysia on November 4, 2026, a national program putting Amazon Quick in the hands of up to 445,000 government officers and Kiro-powered GovHub in a pilot of 500 developers, with a goal of 10,000 small businesses onboarded by 2028.

item.title: Claude maps the first 3D vault particle from bacteria: Anthropic's 96-copy L05 shell
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic said on November 4, 2026, that Claude helped its biology lab map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from prokaryotic cells: a 96-copy L05 shell, 54 by 45 nanometres, produced in E. coli. The vaults' function is still unknown, and the structures and data are yet to be released.

item.title: Colibri v2.1.0: run GGUF models as-is and use the new chat UI — hands-on
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Colibri (JustVugg/colibri, Apache-2.0, 47,760 GitHub stars at the 4 November 2026 check) runs huge open mixture-of-experts models on the machine you already have. Version 2.1.0, released 31 October 2026, reads published GGUF files exactly as they are — no conversion — and adds a new chat UI. This guide installs v2.1.0, imports a GGUF, opens the new UI, and points your other apps at the local server.

item.title: GitHub Copilot comes to Xcode's built-in coding assistant in public preview
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GitHub said on November 4, 2026, that Copilot now works directly in Xcode's built-in coding assistant, in public preview starting with Xcode 27.3 beta. It needs macOS Tahoe 26.6 or later, supports all Copilot plans, and leaves the existing Copilot for Xcode extension as a separate option.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer, bringing Code Storage and Codex's Trees and Diffs libraries in-house
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI said on November 4, 2026, that it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., maker of Code Storage and the Trees and Diffs libraries already used in the Codex app. Code Storage features will move into Codex, Pierre's open-source projects will stay open source, and no price was disclosed.

item.title: Leidos HeadWay Dispatch: AI agent governance that lets operators block, approve, or auto-run agent actions
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Leidos introduced HeadWay Dispatch on November 4, 2026, a platform for governing AI agents from different vendors with three controls — Know, Control, and Prove — plus calibrated autonomy, a tamper-evident Flight Recorder, and a kill switch that works without cloud connectivity.

item.title: TestGrid ONE launches: an AI operating system for quality engineering that runs Selenium, Playwright and Appium suites as written
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: TestGrid launched TestGrid ONE on November 4, 2026: the successor to TestOS that pairs AI agents — CoTester for test generation and AgentRx for self-healing — with real-device and browser infrastructure, running existing Selenium, Playwright and Appium suites without conversion.

item.title: SWE-2 Flash: Cognition's new coding model for Devin runs 3x faster at one-fifth the price of SWE-2
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cognition launched SWE-2 Flash on November 4, 2026, for Devin Desktop and CLI: a coding model built from Thinking Machines' Inkling-Small that runs three times faster than SWE-2 at one-fifth the price — free through November 30, with its weights held back over cybersecurity risks.

item.title: NeuralGCM+: Google gives Ai2 $5M to turn its AI weather model into a climate projector for decades ahead
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google.org is giving the Allen Institute for AI about $5 million, plus $1.8 million in cloud credits, to build NeuralGCM+, an open-source model that extends Google Research's NeuralGCM from weather forecasts of up to a year to climate projections spanning 5 to 50 years.
